description: This file implements polyfills and utilities for web components, including WeakMap, MutationObserver, CustomEvent, and HTMLImports management, as part of the Polymer project's webcomponentsjs library.

classes.name: WeakMap
classes.description: Polyfill for WeakMap if not natively supported, providing set, get, delete, and has methods.

classes.name: JsMutationObserver
classes.description: Polyfill for MutationObserver, providing observe, disconnect, and takeRecords methods.

classes.name: MutationRecord
classes.description: Represents information about mutations observed by MutationObserver.

classes.name: Observer
classes.description: Utility class for observing DOM mutations, used within HTMLImports for import element tracking.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: Handles loading of external resources with caching and deduplication, used in HTMLImports.

methods.name: dispatchCallbacks
methods.description: Dispatches scheduled mutation records to observers.

methods.name: wrapIfNeeded
methods.description: Wraps DOM nodes with ShadowDOMPolyfill if needed.

methods.name: whenReady
methods.description: Executes callback when DOM is ready and imports are loaded.

methods.name: isImportLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a link element's import is loaded.

methods.name: makeDocument
methods.description: Creates a new HTMLDocument from resource string and URL.
